chunk_map.heading: It analysed everything and still had no insight

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L4-6: 'your look-for line' / 'Your digest' name artifacts the trio built in apt101-read-the-digest (arc-earned; sibling slide 'It found what you asked it to look for' precedes in apt101-why-it-agreed); closest to violating, but arc-earned spine carve-out applies and 'It' at L6 resolves to 'your digest' L4. Harm (unresolvable referent) absent.
No callback to other files by position; L12 maintainer mentions are outside body. Closest: L4 'Your digest' names the object, not a file position.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L4 'Your digest read every interview, every ticket' refers to apt101-read-the-digest, which exists (curriculum/trainings/agentic-product-teams-101/whats-actually-true.md L114 lists it). Beat is real.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no guess/predict cue or demo reveal on slide

rules_evaluated.evidence: L4-8: slide carries a self-contained claim (digest analysed everything, still no choice; question posed) - not a wait-state
L1 header 'It analysed everything and still had no insight' is borne out by L4-6 (counts, groups, ranks; headline = look-for line handed back). Closest: 'no insight' vs L6 'not an insight' agree.

L6 'Its headline is your own look-for line handed back, not an insight.' is a single 'X, not Y' tail, not the banned 'Not X. Not Y. Z.'; L4 'counted mentions, grouped themes and ranked them' is a triplet of verbs each concrete; L8 'wider, deeper and faster' adjective triple is a quoted stance. No superlative, no number retraction, no abstraction stack.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep for beat|mood|compendium|forcing function|firing|surface in body_numbered L1-9 -> 0 hits; 'look-for line' is the trio's own exercise vocabulary, not repo dialect.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: bold '**' in body L1-9 -> 0; no emphasis spent.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Included from curriculum/lectures/apt101-why-it-agreed.md L5 as [It analysed everything...](slides/analysed-everything-no-insight.md); lecture is deck-reachable. Slide present in composition.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Numbering — position is computed, content ordinals are linted.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-numbering.js --file curriculum/slides/analysed-everything-no-insight.md -> OK, 1 files, Phase/Step numbering consistent.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Page geometry dies at the cut; reading order survives.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-deixis.js --file ... -> OK, 1 files, no page-geometry pointers across the slide cut.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: In-deck links work now; whether they EARN their place is open.
rules_evaluated.evidence: no links in body L1-9 (grep 'http' 0, no [..](..) ); rule is a review surface, nothing to inventory.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Slide size — 210 words / 6 bullets, and the cap is machine-checked.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-size.js --file ... -> oversized: 0, 1 slide within 210 words / 6 bullets.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L1 lecture-slide header 'It analysed everything and still had no insight' is a claim, as lectures owe; closest to a label but it declares.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: L8 'So what is the insight only your team can bring?' could read as kicker, but it is a question that poses the stance (maintainer L12: answer deliberately withheld to Day 3), restating no header; L6 'None of it is a choice' adds the mechanism. No doctrine restatement, design commentary or koan.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A retitled slide re-earns its bullets against the new header.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Not retitled: first cut 2026-10-07 (L12 STATUS); bullets answer the current header (L4-6 analysed everything / no insight).

notes: Single-chunk slide file; chunk 0 is the whole slide. Rule 1 PASS relies on arc-earned carve-out for 'look-for line'/'digest' (earned in apt101-read-the-digest). Accept-notes: none attest a rule exemption (L12 STATUS, L17 backing claim lines only).
